description: This file defines the CurrentRouteMatch class in Drupal, responsible for managing and retrieving route match information for the current request, including route name, object, parameters, and handling route match caching.

classes.name: CurrentRouteMatch
classes.description: Manages the current route match for a request, providing methods to retrieve route information and handle route match caching.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the CurrentRouteMatch with a RequestStack and sets up route match cache.

methods.name: getRouteName
methods.description: Returns the name of the current route.

methods.name: getRouteObject
methods.description: Returns the route object of the current route.

methods.name: getParameter
methods.description: Retrieves a specific parameter from the current route match.

methods.name: getParameters
methods.description: Returns all parameters of the current route match.

methods.name: getRawParameter
methods.description: Retrieves a raw parameter from the current route match.

methods.name: getRawParameters
methods.description: Returns all raw parameters of the current route match.

methods.name: getCurrentRouteMatch
methods.description: Gets the route match for the current request, or a NullRouteMatch if none.

methods.name: getRouteMatch
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a route match object for a given request.

methods.name: getMasterRouteMatch
methods.description: Gets the route match for the main request.

methods.name: getParentRouteMatch
methods.description: Gets the route match for the parent request.

methods.name: getRouteMatchFromRequest
methods.description: Gets the route match for a specific request.
